name: Scheduled report delivery
summary: Recurring report emails (once, daily, weekly, monthly) and daily-note report settings with recipients and send times.

roles.note: No delivery-schedule permission strings exist in the seed catalog. Custom daily-note recipient lists must include a project admin.

actions.action: Create or edit a report delivery schedule

nfr.statement: How close to the configured time a scheduled report must arrive.
nfr.open_question: Is "within 15 minutes of the configured local time" acceptable, and how are delays detected?

requirements.title: When the next scheduled report is due
requirements.statement: A delivery schedule is once, daily, weekly or monthly. Daily adds a day. Weekly picks the next chosen weekday, a week ahead if that's today. Monthly adds a month and then sets the day. The requester is always added as a recipient. Creating a schedule queues its reports; editing a schedule saves the new date but doesn't re-queue.
open_checks: Check edits and deletions against already-queued or repeating work; the edit path doesn't call the create-time queue step

acceptance_criteria.given: A weekly schedule for Monday, created on a Monday
acceptance_criteria.when: The next date is worked out
acceptance_criteria.then: It is the following Monday, and the requester is a recipient

requirements.title: Daily-note report recipients and send times
requirements.statement: Daily-note reports go to project admins, to all users, or to a custom list. A custom list is de-duplicated and must include at least one project admin (direct or through a group). Send times are on the hour or half hour, in the project's time zone, or UTC if it has none.

acceptance_criteria.given: A custom recipient list with two collaborators and no admin

acceptance_criteria.then: It is rejected, because only :00 and :30 are allowed

requirements.title: Changing the send time keeps an earlier pending send
requirements.statement: When the daily-note send time changes, the next send is the first occurrence after now, unless an existing pending send is sooner, in which case that one is kept. Only time changes reschedule; changing recipients doesn't. Two reports can therefore go out on the same day.

acceptance_criteria.given: A daily send at 18:00 is pending for today, and at 10:00 the time is changed to 08:00
acceptance_criteria.then: (Current behaviour) Today's 18:00 send is kept, and tomorrow's goes at 08:00
